Slow 50mm orbit at chest height with a slight dutch, hard key on the glasses, crushed blacks, cool off-white ribbons of light. keep his face, body and clothing exactly as in the image, keep the environment the same, only add motion and atmosphere.

concepts.title: Rearview stretch
concepts.what_we_see: He looks past camera with getaway calm, no mouthing the line, while a dolly zoom holds his face and stretches the mirrored corridor away behind him like a highway punching to speed.
concepts.why_it_lands: Performance sells the drive in attitude and optics: the gaze of someone checking the mirror, the world ripping backward, zero lip-sync.
concepts.camera: 85mm dolly zoom, push in as the corridor recedes
concepts.motion_and_fx: Almost no body motion besides a breath and a tiny forward lean; one hard light sweeps his glasses like a passing headlight; environment perspective stretches, blacks stay crushed.
concepts.risk_reason: Dolly zoom from a still often warps face or architecture; keep the stretch slow and his features locked.
concepts.broll_prompt: a lean Black man with a connected short beard, clear-framed glasses, a navy baseball cap, wearing a cream knit track jacket zipped up with a navy chest band carrying small gold lettering, a white striped shirt and a striped tie inside the stand collar, black trousers looks past camera with a still, getaway-calm stare, mouth closed, a tiny forward lean, hands simple and low, as the dark mirrored corridor with tall vertical white light strips stretches away behind him on the wet black floor. 85mm dolly zoom holding his face while the hall recedes, one hard key sweep across the glasses like a passing headlight, crushed blacks, cool off-white accents. keep his face, body and clothing exactly as in the image, keep the environment the same, only add motion and atmosphere.
